name: Compras.gov.br open-data API (SICAF supplier registry)
operator: Ministerio da Gestao e da Inovacao em Servicos Publicos (Compras.gov.br)
tier_rationale: Federal procurement system of the Ministerio da Gestao (government body, A8 trusted); open government API (P246 cond 5).

reliability.justification: SICAF supplier records of the federal procurement system; contracts are organ-centric in this API (codigoOrgao and a validity window are required), so only the supplier record is CNPJ-centric.

sicaf_fornecedor.title: Compras.gov.br modulo-fornecedor 1_consultarFornecedor by CNPJ (SICAF supplier record)

terms.quote: Official open data (BNDES, MinC, PNCP), tier trusted.

sicaf_fornecedor.notes: Quote: binding council text (P246 cond 5); research C0574 terms 'Open government API (spec at /v3/api-docs)'. The research 404 'Resource not found' came from a missing required parameter: with ativo=true the supplier query answered 200 from the prep egress on 2026-11-26 (fixture). P246 cond 2-3 keep the source behind requires_egress BR (A9) until a success fixture is captured from the team's Brazilian egress; a 403, challenge, geo-block or empty reply is BLOCKED 'could not verify', never 'no contracts'; a 404 'Resource not found' is a query error, never an absence. Partners (masked names), e-mail and phone are never kept. Used by br_public_spending_br.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-2 (P246 br_public_spending_br). Azure Front Door; 1 request/s, answers cached 24 h. No quota block. Never through a VPN, proxy exit or IP rotation chosen to defeat a geo-block (A9).
